Initialization.description: User accesses the UI Builder environment. This is the entry point to the workflow with no previous state dependencies. The system loads the component library index and user permissions.

Component library navigation.description: User browses available components. Involves filtering, searching, and categorization operations. Components are presented according to permission-based visibility rules. Each component has associated metadata (type, constraints, data requirements).

Component selection.description: User identifies and selects a specific component. Selection triggers component metadata loading. The system validates component accessibility based on user permissions. Preparation for canvas integration begins.

Canvas integration.description: Component is positioned in the workspace. Spatial coordinates are assigned. The layout engine evaluates placement validity. The component enters an unpopulated/unconfigured state.

Property configuration.description: Component attributes are defined. Properties are categorized by function (visual, behavioral, data-related). Default values may be pre-populated. Validation rules are applied per property. This is a highly iterative state with frequent revisitation.

Data connection.description: Data sources are mapped to the component. Data binding operations occur between component properties and data models. Transformations can be defined for data preprocessing. The system validates data type compatibility.

Preview.description: Component functionality is tested. The rendering engine generates a visual representation. Interactive elements become operational. Data integration is simulated.

Requirements evaluation.description: Component is assessed against requirements. Decision point: meets requirements or requires modification. Failed evaluation creates a feedback loop to Property Configuration State. Success advances workflow to next stage.

Dashboard preservation.description: Current state is persisted. Configuration data is serialized. The version control system records the state snapshot. Dependencies are documented.

Validation.description: Comprehensive dashboard evaluation occurs. Component interactions are assessed. Data flow is verified. Performance metrics are evaluated. Accessibility compliance is checked.

Resolution.description: Issues identified during validation are addressed. Recursive process until validation passes. May involve returning to earlier states for specific components.

Publication.description: Dashboard is finalized and made available. Access controls are applied. Resource allocation occurs. Monitoring systems are activated. Distribution mechanisms are triggered.
